name: dnsrecon
summary: Python script for enumeration of hosts, subdomains and emails from a given domain using google.
highlights: -iL — File containing a list of domains to perform DNS enumeration on, one per line.
-n — Domain server to use. If none is given, the SOA of the target will be used. Multiple serve
-r — IP range for reverse lookup brute force in formats (first-last) or in (range/bitmask).
-D — Dictionary file of subdomain and hostnames to use for brute force.
-f — Filter out of brute force domain lookup, records that resolve to the wildcard defined IP a
-s — Perform a reverse lookup of IPv4 ranges in the SPF record with standard enumeration.

flags.name: --help
flags.description: show this help message and exit

flags.name: --domain
flags.description: Target domain.

flags.name: --input-list
flags.description: File containing a list of domains to perform DNS enumeration on, one per line.

flags.name: --name_server
flags.description: Domain server to use. If none is given, the SOA of the target will be used. Multiple servers can be specified using a comma separated list.

flags.name: --range
flags.description: IP range for reverse lookup brute force in formats (first-last) or in (range/bitmask).

flags.name: --dictionary
flags.description: Dictionary file of subdomain and hostnames to use for brute force.

flags.name: -f
flags.description: Filter out of brute force domain lookup, records that resolve to the wildcard defined IP address when saving records.

flags.name: -a
flags.description: Perform AXFR with standard enumeration.

flags.name: -s
flags.description: Perform a reverse lookup of IPv4 ranges in the SPF record with standard enumeration.

flags.name: -b
flags.description: Perform Bing enumeration with standard enumeration.

flags.name: -y
flags.description: Perform Yandex enumeration with standard enumeration.

flags.name: -k
flags.description: Perform crt.sh enumeration with standard enumeration.

flags.name: -w
flags.description: Perform deep whois record analysis and reverse lookup of IP ranges found through Whois when doing a standard enumeration.

flags.name: --shodan
flags.description: Use Shodan to query netblocks discovered via SPF (-s) and/or Whois (-w) during standard enumeration.

flags.name: --shodan-active
flags.description: Actively validate Shodan-discovered names by resolving them and confirming they still match the queried netblock.

flags.name: --shodan-key
flags.description: Shodan API key. If omitted, SHODAN_API_KEY environment variable is used.

flags.name: -z
flags.description: Performs a DNSSEC zone walk with standard enumeration.

flags.name: --threads
flags.description: Number of threads to use in reverse lookups, forward lookups, brute force and SRV record enumeration.

flags.name: --lifetime
flags.description: Time to wait for a server to respond to a query. default is 3.0

flags.name: --loglevel
flags.description: Log level to use. default is INFO

flags.name: --tcp
flags.description: Use TCP protocol to make queries.

flags.name: --db
flags.description: SQLite 3 file to save found records.

flags.name: --xml
flags.description: XML file to save found records.

flags.name: --csv
flags.description: Save output to a comma separated value file.

flags.name: --json
flags.description: save output to a JSON file.

flags.name: --iw
flags.description: Continue brute forcing a domain even if a wildcard record is discovered.

flags.name: --disable_check_nxdomain
flags.description: Disables check for NXDOMAIN hijacking on name servers.

flags.name: --disable_check_recursion
flags.description: Disables check for recursion on name servers

flags.name: --disable_recurs
flags.description: Disable recursion desired flag in queries.

flags.name: --disable_check_bindversion
flags.description: Disables check for BIND version on name servers

flags.name: --version
flags.description: DNSrecon version

flags.name: --verbose
flags.description: Enable verbosity

flags.name: --type
flags.description: Type of enumeration to perform. Possible types: std: SOA, NS, A, AAAA, MX and SRV. rvl: Reverse lookup of a given CIDR or IP range. brt: Brute force domains and hosts using a given dictionary. srv: SRV records. axfr: Test all NS servers for a zone transfer. bing: Perform Bing search for subdomains and hosts. yand: Perform Yandex search for subdomains and hosts. crt: Perform crt.sh search for subdomains and hosts. caa: CAA records. snoop: Perform cache snooping against all NS servers for a given domain, testing all with file containing the domains, file given with -D option.

examples.explanation: Scan a domain and save the results to an SQLite database
Scan a domain, specifying the nameserver and performing a zone transfer
Scan a domain, using a brute-force attack and a dictionary of subdomains and hostnames
Scan a domain, performing a reverse lookup of IP ranges from the SPF record and saving the results to a JSON file
Scan a domain, performing DNS cache snooping
Scan a domain, performing zone walking
